_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
description: Choose how to finish the Mario Kart 8 Deluxe Manual world.
Token variants require the selected objective plus the configured MKTV Token count.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

dlc.description: Enable Mario Kart 8 Deluxe DLC and Booster Course Pass items and checks. If this is false, all DLC waves are disabled even when individual wave options are true.

dlc_wave_1.description: Enable Wave 1 Booster Course Pass cups and checks. Ignored when DLC Enabled is false.

dlc_wave_2.description: Enable Wave 2 Booster Course Pass cups and checks. Ignored when DLC Enabled is false.

dlc_wave_3.description: Enable Wave 3 Booster Course Pass cups and checks. Ignored when DLC Enabled is false.

dlc_wave_4.description: Enable Wave 4 Booster Course Pass cups, characters, and checks. Ignored when DLC Enabled is false.

dlc_wave_5.description: Enable Wave 5 Booster Course Pass cups, characters, and checks. Ignored when DLC Enabled is false.

dlc_wave_6.description: Enable Wave 6 Booster Course Pass cups, characters, and checks. Ignored when DLC Enabled is false.

golden.description: Enable all golden unlock items and related checks. If this is false, individual golden item options are ignored.

golden_mario.description: Enable Golden Mario and its related check. Ignored when Golden Unlocks is false.

gold_standard.description: Enable the Gold Standard kart item. Ignored when Golden Unlocks is false.

gold_tires.description: Enable the Gold Tires wheel item. Ignored when Golden Unlocks is false.

golden_glider.description: Enable the Golden Glider item. Ignored when Golden Unlocks is false.

description: Choose how many MKTV Tokens are required for the Mario Kart 8 Token goal.
MKTV Tokens are only added to the item pool when the selected goal requires them.
Controls how many MKTV Token items are placed compared to the required amount.
100 means only the required amount is placed. 200 means double the required amount is placed.
The final amount is capped at 100 MKTV Tokens.
Controls how characters that share a selection slot are handled.
Separate keeps every color or form as its own item.
Progressive replaces each group with repeated Progressive items.
Character Only uses one item to unlock every color or form in that group.
Controls how Time Trial ghost checks are included.
Single creates one Nintendo ghost check per track without an engine-class requirement.
Split 150/200 creates separate 150cc and 200cc Nintendo ghost checks.
Enable optional course-specific challenge checks.
Each check requires any race mode, any unlocked engine class, and the related cup.
Enable all race items as one group.
When disabled, all race item progression items and checks that directly require them are removed.
Battle checks no longer require a battle-damage item when race items are disabled.
Enable optional checks for using each race item.
Checks can be cleared in Grand Prix, VS Race, or Battle Mode when the needed mode requirements are unlocked.
Enable kart body, wheel, and glider progression items as one group.
When disabled, all kart bodies, wheels, gliders, and checks that directly require them are removed.
Enable optional checks for winning a race with each kart body, wheel, and glider.
All vehicle part challenge checks share the same Kart Challenges category.
Enable optional VS Race checks for winning configured race counts with or without teams.
These checks require VS Race, a race count setting, a team setting, VS item/COM/course settings, enough unlocked cups, and the selected engine class.
Enable optional Battle Mode round-count challenge checks.

These checks require Battle, the selected Battle mode, the round count setting, valid Battle item/COM/vehicle/course settings, at least one non-Coin battle item, and the mode-specific team or round-time settings.
Enable engine-class progression items: 50cc, 100cc, 150cc, Mirror, and 200cc.
When disabled, engine-class items and engine-specific checks are removed, then clean no-difficulty versions of those checks are used instead.

run_50cc.description: Enable the 50cc item and its matching checks. Ignored when Difficulty Items is disabled.

run_100cc.description: Enable the 100cc item and its matching checks. Ignored when Difficulty Items is disabled.

run_150cc.description: Enable the 150cc item and its matching checks. Ignored when Difficulty Items is disabled.

run_mirror.description: Enable the Mirror item and its matching checks. Ignored when Difficulty Items is disabled.

run_200cc.description: Enable the 200cc item and its matching checks. Ignored when Difficulty Items is disabled.

game_modes.description: Enable all game mode progression items. Keep at least one individual game mode enabled.

game_mode_battle.description: Enable the Battle game mode item. Locations that only rely on disabled game modes are removed.

game_mode_grand_prix.description: Enable the Grand Prix game mode item. Locations that only rely on disabled game modes are removed.

game_mode_time_trial.description: Enable the Time Trial game mode item. Locations that only rely on disabled game modes are removed.

game_mode_vs_race.description: Enable the VS Race game mode item. Locations that only rely on disabled game modes are removed.

battle_modes.description: Enable all Battle mode items and checks that directly require them.

battle_mode_balloon_battle.description: Enable the Balloon Battle Battle mode item and checks that directly require it.

battle_mode_bob_omb_blast.description: Enable the Bob-omb Blast Battle mode item and checks that directly require it.

battle_mode_coin_runners.description: Enable the Coin Runners Battle mode item and checks that directly require it.

battle_mode_renegade_roundup.description: Enable the Renegade Roundup Battle mode item and checks that directly require it.

battle_mode_shine_thief.description: Enable the Shine Thief Battle mode item and checks that directly require it.

description: Enable the Team Game and No Teams mode setting items.
These settings are used by VS Race and most Battle Mode logic.
Enable item-rule mode setting items for Battle and VS Race.
This includes Frantic, Custom, Normal, Skilled, No Items, No Items or Coins, Shell Only, Bananas Only, Mushroom Only, and Bob-ombs Only.

mode_setting_round_time.description: Enable all Battle round time setting items from 1 Minute through 5 Minutes.

mode_setting_com.description: Enable Easy COM, Normal COM, and Hard COM setting items.

mode_setting_com_vehicles.description: Enable All Vehicles, Kart Only, and Bikes Only setting items.

mode_setting_courses.description: Enable Choose Courses, In Order Courses, and Random Courses setting items.

mode_setting_rounds.description: Enable all Battle round count setting items from 4 Rounds through 24 Rounds.

mode_setting_races.description: Enable all VS Race count setting items from 4 Races through 48 Races.
